messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable 3D street-driving game inspired by Need for Speed Underground, set in a Tokyo-inspired city.
- Include touch controls, multiple cars, and car-tuning accessories.

## Requirements
- Spanish-language request; playable on desktop and mobile.
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions.

## Decisions
- Implemented a self-contained Three.js game in `index.html`, with procedural city geometry and a neon-night visual style.
- Added three selectable cars, paint colors, spoiler/neon/rim tuning, free-roam checkpoints, nitro, minimap, and keyboard/touch controls.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created the playable game UI and gameplay in `index.html`.
- Extracted the module script and passed `node --check` syntax validation.

### Active
- Browser verification and screenshot capture have not yet been completed.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Open the running game at `http://localhost:3002` with Playwright and inspect the rendered scene.
2. Start the game, check driving and garage interactions, review browser console errors, and save/read the latest small JPEG screenshot.
3. Fix any issues found and report the remaining assumptions.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Complete game implementation; currently the only file created for the game.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `git status --short` showed `index.html` and several repository files as untracked.
- A Python HTTP server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- The game loads Three.js and fonts from CDNs.
